i18nLiteral.A white pupil present from birth, with p: Mwana woyera yemwe amakhalapo kuyambira kubadwa, wosawona bwino, amakhala ndi ng'ala yobadwa nayo.
i18nLiteral.Gradual, painless worsening vision over: Kuwona kwapang'onopang'ono, kosapweteka kwa miyezi yambiri mwa munthu wachikulire kumagwirizana ndi ng'ala.
i18nLiteral.A white pupil in a young child with redu: Wophunzira woyera mwa mwana wamng'ono yemwe ali ndi vuto la kuchepa kwa maso akukhudzana ndi retinoblastoma.
i18nLiteral.Acute onset, pink eye, yellow discharge: Kuyamba koopsa, diso lapinki, kutuluka kwachikasu ndi zizindikiro zowonjezereka zimakhala zogwirizana kwambiri ndi conjunctivitis.
i18nLiteral.Long-term irritation with painful gritty: Kupsa mtima kwa nthawi yayitali ndikumva zowawa, diso lofiira ndi kusawona bwino kumagwirizana ndi trichiasis ndi zipsera.
i18nLiteral.Corneal trauma followed by increasing pa: Kuvulala kwa cornea kutsatiridwa ndi kuwonjezeka kwa ululu, kufiira ndi kutaya masomphenya kumasonyeza chilonda cha cornea.
i18nLiteral.Unilateral gritty watery eye with a rece: Diso lotuwa lotuwa lomwe lili ndi chotupa chaposachedwa cha milomo limakwanira herpes simplex keratitis.
i18nLiteral.Photophobia with watery eye and blurred: Photophobia yokhala ndi diso lamadzi komanso kusawona bwino zikuwonetsa anterior uveitis.
i18nLiteral.Slowly progressive irritation and blur i: Kupsa mtima pang'onopang'ono ndi kusawona bwino mwa munthu wachikulire, nthawi zambiri diso limodzi, kumafika pa pterygium.
i18nLiteral.Foreign body exposure (working under a c: Kuwonekera kwa thupi lachilendo (kugwira ntchito pansi pa galimoto) ndi gritty, zizindikiro zowonjezereka zimasonyeza kuti thupi lachilendo ndilokhazikika ndi matenda oyambirira.
i18nLiteral.Blunt trauma with red eye and very poor: Kuvulala koopsa ndi diso lofiira ndi kusawona bwino kumasonyeza hyphaema.
i18nLiteral.Stick injury with pain, red eye and wors: Kuvulala kwa ndodo ndi ululu, diso lofiira ndi masomphenya oipitsitsa akhoza kusonyeza kuphulika kwa cornea.
i18nLiteral.Stick injury with very poor vision and r: Kuvulala kwa ndodo ndi kusawona bwino kwambiri ndi diso lofiira kungasonyeze kuvulala kolowera komwe kumayambitsa ng'ala yopweteka.
i18nLiteral.You have used both attempts. Moving to t: Mwagwiritsa ntchito zonse ziwiri. Kusamukira ku nkhani yotsatira.
i18nLiteral.Slow, painless vision loss over months t: Kuwonongeka kwapang'onopang'ono, kopanda ululu kwa miyezi ndi zaka ndi diso loyera komanso chiwopsezo chokulirapo ndi mbiri yaku Africa, mbiri yabanja, zaka zopitilira 40 komanso kusawona pang'ono kumagwirizana ndi POAG.
i18nLiteral.Fast vision loss over hours to days with: Kutaya masomphenya mwachangu kwa maola ambiri mpaka masiku ndi diso lofiira lopweteka komanso ma halo ozungulira magetsi okhala ndi chiopsezo chachikulu chokhala ndi mbiri yaku Asia, ukalamba ndi ng'ala zomwe zimakwanira ACAG.
i18nLiteral.My vision is not as good as it used to b: Masomphenya anga sali bwino monga analili kale. Zakhala zikusintha pang'onopang'ono.
i18nLiteral.It started a long time ago, maybe months: Zinayamba kalekale, mwina miyezi mpaka zaka.
i18nLiteral.It came on slowly. There was no injury o: Zinafika pang'onopang'ono. Panalibe chovulala kapena chochitika chadzidzidzi.
i18nLiteral.No redness and no discharge. The eye loo: Palibe kufiira komanso kutulutsa. Diso likuwoneka loyera.
i18nLiteral.Yes, the vision has been getting worse,: Inde, masomphenyawo akhala akuipiraipira, koma pang’onopang’ono.
i18nLiteral.I am short sighted and I wear glasses fo: Ndine waufupi ndipo ndimavala magalasi kutali. Bambo anga anali ndi glaucoma. Ndili ndi zaka 40.
i18nLiteral.My vision suddenly became blurry and my: Maso anga anasintha mwadzidzidzi ndipo diso langa likupweteka kwambiri.
i18nLiteral.It started suddenly, within the last few: Zinayamba mwadzidzidzi, mkati mwa maola angapo apitawa.
i18nLiteral.Yes, the eye is red. There is no dischar: Inde, diso ndi lofiira. Palibe kutulutsa.
i18nLiteral.Yes, the vision got worse quickly over h: Inde, masomphenyawo anafika poipa kwambiri patapita maola ambiri.
i18nLiteral.I see halos around lights. I have had a: Ndikuwona kuwala kozungulira magetsi. Ndinachitapo chiwembu chofananacho chisanathe. Ndimaona nthawi yayitali ndipo ndikufuna magalasi kuti ndiwonere pafupi. Ndauzidwa kuti ndili ndi ng'ala.
i18nLiteral.Clinical signs are consistent with this: Zizindikiro zachipatala zimagwirizana ndi chizindikiro ichi.
i18nLiteral.Good vision and long outdoor work make t: Kuwona bwino komanso kugwira ntchito kwanthawi yayitali kumapangitsa kuti izi zitheke.
i18nLiteral.Gritty painful eye after metal work sugg: Diso lopweteka pambuyo pa ntchito yachitsulo limasonyeza thupi lachilendo la cornea.
i18nLiteral.Light sensitivity and blurred vision sug: Kuzindikira kopepuka komanso kusawona bwino zikuwonetsa kuti matenda ayamba msanga.
i18nLiteral.Listen to what the patient says and tap: Mvetserani zomwe wodwala akunena ndikudina chithunzi chomwe chikugwirizana bwino ndi matendawo.
i18nLiteral.Long-term gritty pain with blurry vision: Kupweteka kwa nthawi yayitali ndi kusawona bwino kumasonyeza kuwonongeka kosatha pamwamba.
Mwana wanga ali ndi masabata awiri.
i18nLiteral.Newborn age and maternal STI history sup: Zaka zobadwa kumene komanso mbiri ya matenda opatsirana pogonana amathandizira gonococcal/chlamydial conjunctivitis.
i18nLiteral.No red eye or discharge suggests catarac: Palibe diso lofiira kapena kutuluka magazi komwe kumasonyeza ng'ala, osati matenda a maso.
i18nLiteral.One painful light-sensitive eye with wat: Diso limodzi lopweteka losamva kuwala ndi kufiira kwamadzi ndikuwonetsa keratitis.
i18nLiteral.Painful red eye with fast decline suppor: Kupweteka kwa diso lofiira ndi kuchepa mofulumira kumathandiza ng'ala yopweteka.
i18nLiteral.Photophobia, pain, and blurred vision in: Photophobia, ululu, ndi kusawona bwino m'diso limodzi zimasonyeza uveitis.
i18nLiteral.Poor visual attention supports this diag: Kusawoneka bwino kumathandizira kuzindikira kumeneku ndipo kumafunikira kutumizidwa mwachangu.
i18nLiteral.Recent painful lip sores support herpes: Zilonda zowawa zaposachedwa zimathandizira herpes simplex keratitis.
i18nLiteral.Repeated similar episodes support anteri: Zochitika zobwerezabwereza zofananira zimathandizira anterior uveitis.
i18nLiteral.Severe pain and red eye after a scratch: Kupweteka kwambiri ndi diso wofiira pambuyo zikande ku chitsamba amati cornea chilonda.
i18nLiteral.Severe vision loss after stick trauma su: Kutaya masomphenya kwambiri pambuyo pa kuvulala kwa ndodo kumasonyeza kuvulala kwa diso lolowera.
i18nLiteral.Stick injury with worsening pain and blu: Kuvulala kwa ndodo ndi ululu wowonjezereka ndi kusawona bwino kumasonyeza kuvulala kwapadziko lonse.
i18nLiteral.Sudden vision loss after blunt trauma is: Kutaya masomphenya mwadzidzidzi pambuyo pa kuvulala koopsa ndizochitika kwa traumatic hyphaema.
i18nLiteral.Thick yellow discharge and pink eyes sug: Kutopa kwachikasu ndi maso apinki kumasonyeza kuti bakiteriya conjunctivitis.
i18nLiteral.This pattern fits penetrating corneal la: Njira iyi imagwirizana ndi kuphulika kwa cornea ndi iris prolapse.
i18nLiteral.This pattern fits trachomatous trichiasi: Njira iyi imagwirizana ndi trachomatous trichiasis yokhala ndi zipsera za cornea.
i18nLiteral.This sticky red-eye pattern can be due t: Kumata kwa diso lofiira la diso likhoza kukhala chifukwa cha matenda a gonococcal/chlamydial.
i18nLiteral.Vision became worse slowly over many mon: Masomphenya anakula pang'onopang'ono kwa miyezi yambiri, popanda kupweteka.
i18nLiteral.A painful red watering eye with shadow v: Diso lofiira lofiira lofiira lokhala ndi mthunzi wowoneka bwino limathandizira matendawa.
i18nLiteral.A slow-growing pink patch with mild grit: Chigamba cha pinki chomwe chikukula pang'onopang'ono chokhala ndi grit sensation chikuwonetsa pterygium.
i18nLiteral.A white pupil in a baby is a key danger: Wophunzira woyera mwa khanda ndiye chizindikiro chachikulu chowopsa cha retinoblastoma.
i18nLiteral.Discharge and very poor vision support b: Kutulutsa komanso kusawona bwino kumathandizira matenda a bakiteriya/fungal cornea.

i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_account_security:
Ngati mupanga akaunti, chonde sungani zolowera zanu motetezedwa.
Muli ndi udindo pazochitika muakaunti yanu pokhapokha mutatidziwitsa zakugwiritsa ntchito molakwika kapena vuto lachitetezo.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_education_only: Pulogalamuyi ndi chida chophunzitsira chothandizira kuphunzira ndi kukonzanso. Siupangiri wamaphunziro, zamalamulo kapena akatswiri ndipo sizingatsimikizire kuti mayeso, magiredi kapena zotsatira zinazake. Zosankha zamaphunziro ndi zosankha zimakhalabe udindo wa wogwiritsa ntchito.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_how_we_use_data:
Deta imeneyi imathandizira kuti pulogalamuyi igwirizane ndi zolinga za munthu aliyense, kumvetsetsa momwe pulogalamuyi imagwiritsidwira ntchito komanso kusintha mawonekedwe ake pakapita nthawi. Itha kugwiritsidwanso ntchito kulumikizana ndi zosintha zofunika pa pulogalamu kapena akaunti.
Zolemba zanu sizigulitsidwa konse.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_identity_check: Chidziwitso chingafunikire kutsimikiziridwa pempho lisanamalizidwe. Ngati chidziwitso chilichonse chiyenera kusungidwa pazifukwa zalamulo kapena chitetezo, izi zidzafotokozedwa.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_minimum_data: Zomwe zimafunikira pakuyendetsa ndikuwongolera ntchito ndizosonkhanitsidwa.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_service_limits: Cholinga chake ndikupangitsa kuti pulogalamuyi ikhale yothandiza komanso yodalirika, koma palibe ntchito yomwe ili yabwino. Kupezeka kosalekeza kapena kumasuka kwathunthu ku zolakwika sikungalonjezedwe, ndipo pulogalamuyi siyingagwirizane ndi vuto lililonse.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_storage: Zambiri zimasungidwa pa seva yoyendetsedwa ndi database yoperekedwa ndi Railway. Railway imapereka mayendedwe ndi zomangamanga; timalamulira momwe deta imagwiritsidwira ntchito mu pulogalamuyi ndikuisunga kwa nthawi yomwe ikufunika.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_third_party: Timadalira ntchito zodalirika za chipani chachitatu, monga operekera alendo, kuti tigwiritse ntchito pulogalamuyi. Ntchitozi zimangokonza zomwe zikufunika kuti zipereke zomanga ndipo alibe chilolezo chozigwiritsa ntchito pazolinga zawo.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_uk_law_limits: Monga momwe malamulo aku UK amaloleza, sitili ndi udindo pa zotayika monga zophonya, ndalama zomwe zatayika kapena mwayi womwe umabwera chifukwa chogwiritsa ntchito, kapena kulephera kugwiritsa ntchito pulogalamuyi. Palibe pano chomwe chimachotsa ufulu uliwonse woperekedwa ndi malamulo aku UK.
i18nExtra.secondary_glaucoma_prompt:
Zomwe zapeza zimatha kukweza diso ndikuyambitsa glaucoma yachiwiri.
Kokani chilichonse chomwe mwapeza m'bokosi lolondola.

i18nExtra.visualsystem_step0:
Maso amatenga kuwala
kuchokera kudziko ndikutembenuza
this kukhala ma siginecha a ubongo
kuti apange 'masomphenya'.
i18nExtra.visualsystem_step1:
Kuwala kumayang'ana pa
kumbuyo kwa diso
ndi cornea ndi mandala.
i18nExtra.visualsystem_step3:
Izi zili ngati sensa kapena filimu
in kamera yomwe imatembenuza
light kukhala zizindikiro zamagetsi
zomwe zimaperekedwa ku ubongo
pansi pa mitsempha ya optic.

Ubongo kenako umapanga
vision kuchokera kuzizindikirozi.
